स्प्रन्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
 1. Throbbing, beating.
 2. Gone.
 n. (-तं) A pulsa-
tion.
 E. स्पदि to throb, क्त्व aff.

स्प्रष्टृ mfn. (-ष्टा-ष्ट्री-ष्टृ) Who or what touches, &c.
 m. (-ष्टा)
 1. Morbid
heat.
 2. The agent or instrumental cause of pain or distress, as
an enemy, a disease, &c.
 E. स्पृश् to touch, तृच् aff., and the first ऋ
converted to र; also स्पर्ष्टृ ।
